::: tip
This page explains how to use flat config files.
:::

You can put your ESLint project configuration in a configuration file. You can include built-in rules, how you want them enforced, plugins with custom rules, shareable configurations, which files you want rules to apply to, and more.

---
title: Share Configurations
eleventyNavigation:
    key: share configs
    parent: extend eslint
    title: Share Configurations
    order: 3
---

To share your ESLint configuration, create a **shareable config**. You can publish your shareable config on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/) so that others can download and use it in their ESLint projects.

This page explains how to create and publish a shareable config.

::: tip
This page explains how to create a shareable config using the flat config format.
:::

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
